performance_case.causal_mechanism: Freeing blocked DRA capacity through route-substitution cooldowns or profitable-incumbent rotation may improve capital reuse, but only if the causal repair survives within-study Validation realized PnL, drawdown, holding, terminal-inventory and annual-breadth gates rather than shifting losses or marks across paths.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may issue only a terminal family-level retention or closure verdict from two exact sealed pre-2025 diagnostics. It cannot compare absolute economics across different parent/capital contracts, rerun or tune either study, access clean OOS or forward evidence, create a hypothesis or candidate, alter source, adapter, runner or runtime, or establish future fee-adjusted PnL, drawdown, deployability or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: A valid capital-release mechanism should not worsen within-study Validation drawdown or annual drawdown breadth while improving realized economics; these sealed diagnostics can only reject or retain the family for later audit, not establish future drawdown improvement.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A terminal closure prevents further rescue tuning of 168-hour/60-USDT vetoes and rotation thresholds when existing causal/accounting repairs already fail risk-adjusted Validation gates, reserving research capacity for independent forward mechanisms.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Only a separately preregistered future mechanism with within-study equal-capital gains in realized and total PnL, non-worse drawdown, holding and breadth could improve performance; this terminal audit has zero immediate effect.
